title: Chapter 1465 - 10: Am I The Greatest Calamity For The Legendary Lords?
content:
Chapter 1465 - 10: Am I The Greatest Calamity For The Legendary Lords?

Chapter 1465 - 10: Am I the Greatest Calamity for the Legendary Lords?

"Wise one, what have you discovered?"

Fantian Lord sharply sensed the wise one's change before and after, immediately asking.

From his angle, looking up, even to the end of his line of sight, he couldn't see Lin Yuan's silhouette.

Other Legendary Lords who underwent three hundred million tribulations also looked towards the wise one.

As the first Legendary Lord to step onto the unified white jade steps, surely he felt something unusual.

"It turns out... the first one we competed to step onto the white jade steps... has long since left."

The wise one chuckled softly, self-mockingly.

With the wise one's mindset, if he was only slightly ahead, he would never feel such a sense of utter despair.

Were other Legendary Lords slightly ahead of him? Or did he never win against competing with Lord Haotian and Fantian Lord, among other Legendary Lords?

It would only stir greater motivation in the wise one.

But Lin Yuan?

At this moment, the wise one, though on the unified white jade steps, was separated from Lin Yuan by countless white jade steps, a gap as vast as a chasm.

No matter how great the motivation or competitiveness, it would be thoroughly worn away in the face of such disparity.

"Long since left?"

"Wise one, what do you mean?"

"Yes, could it be that someone climbed the unified white jade steps before you?"

Lord Wan Xiang, Lord Haotian, and other Legendary Lords, with their quick minds, immediately deduced most of the truth from the wise one's words.

Only this truth was hard for all Legendary Lords to believe.

Wasn't the wise one the first to ascend the unified white jade steps?

Then who was it?

From their position, they could already see a long stretch of the unified white jade steps.

They hadn't seen any other climbers.

"Did you not sense that there's another presence who hasn't appeared until now?"

The wise one sighed internally, then spoke.

"Are you referring to the Galaxy?"

Lord Wan Xiang's expression shifted slightly.

Not only had the wise one guarded against the Galaxy, but Lord Wan Xiang and others were also wary of the Galaxy Lord.

After all, in the small circle of Lord Wan Xiang, Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other four Legendary Lords, there was a notion of jointly opposing the Galaxy Lord.

But even until the wise one ascended the unified white jade steps, the Galaxy Lord hadn't appeared.

"Yes."

"The Galaxy Lord, he ascended long ago."

The wise one spoke.

There was no need to conceal this fact.

"Ascended long ago?"

"What kind of means does the Galaxy Lord possess?"

Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary Lords were silent for

a moment, their expressions reflecting astonishment.

They did not doubt the wise one.

Because only this explanation made sense.

Otherwise, given the Galaxy Lord's strength surpassing Lord Haotian

and Fantian Lord, why hadn't he appeared in front of the unified

white jade steps until now?

It could only be explained by his having already crossed them.

"It seems the Galaxy Lord hid his strength when he acted against Lord

Zhuo He."

"Indeed."

"Wise one, why can't I see how high the Galaxy Lord has climbed?"

"Yes, I can't see either. Could it be that only by stepping onto the unified white jade steps can one see the scene on the steps after unification?"

Lord Haotian and seven other Legendary Lords felt somewhat puzzled, speculating it might be a limitation of the steps' rules-that not stepping onto the unified steps restricts one's view of the scene on the steps after unification.

"You can't see... it's normal..."

The wise one glanced at each Legendary Lord and said in a mysterious tone: "The Galaxy Lord is currently at a very high position, so high that even I see it very faintly."

Lin Yuan continued climbing the white jade steps, casually glancing

downward.

He saw the struggle among Lord Haotian and eight other Legendary Lords over who would be the first to step onto the unified white jade

steps.

"Reached there just now?" Lin Yuan shook his head slightly. At this

moment, it had been over ten thousand years since he first stepped onto the unified white jade steps.

Lin Yuan merely cast a glance and then paid no more attention.

After all, the gap between him and the Legendary Lords like Lord

Haotian was really too large now.

There was no need to look more.

"The difficulty of climbing the white jade steps after unification..."

Lin Yuan's thoughts fluctuated, a smile appearing on his face. Although the climbing difficulty increased greatly, the effect was very significant.

After more than ten thousand years of climbing, Lin Yuan already comprehended the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Chu Dao, and Chaotic Origin Tai Shi Dao from the "Innate Five Great."

Plus his original Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

He was only short of the Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao to theoretically

match the five types of Chaotic Origin Dao that correspond to the "Innate Five Great."

"Once all five types of Chaotic Origin Dao are comprehended, it will be a qualitative metamorphosis for me, akin to the great leap from non-temporal life to temporal life!"

Lin Yuan felt a sense of insight.

"But why do I feel that even if I comprehend the Chaotic Origin Tai Su

Dao, the 'Innate Five Great' completed by the five types of Chaotic Origin Dao would still be far from reaching the Supreme Rule Dao

level?"

Lin Yuan was slightly puzzled.

The higher the realm and the stronger the power, the more clearly

one perceives the distance from transcending levels as being

unfathomable.

"Take it slow, first comprehend the Chaotic Origin Tai Su Dao." Lin

Yuan restrained his thoughts, climbing the white jade steps, with the path to transcendence clearly visible. Lin Yuan only needed to continue walking down this path.

After unification, the white jade steps.

After the wise one, Lord Haotian, Fantian Lord, and other Legendary

Lords also successively distinguished themselves, stepping into the second stage of the white jade steps.

Even with the Galaxy Lord far ahead, Lord Haotian and other Legendary Lords still held great expectations for climbing the white

jade steps.
